business_summary: Dong-Ah Geological Engineering Company Ltd. operates as a construction company in South Korea and internationally. The company undertakes tunnel construction, ground improvement, and engineering works. Dong-Ah Geological Engineering Company Ltd. was founded in 1971 and is headquartered in Busan, South Korea.
business_summary_ko: 동아지질엔지니어링(Dong-A Geological Engineering Company Ltd.)은 한국 및 해외에서 건설 회사로 활동하고 있습니다. 터널 건설, 지반개량, 토목공사 등을 수행하는 회사입니다. 동아지질공학주식회사는 1971년에 설립되었으며 대한민국 부산에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
